files.content:
name: CI Checks
on: push

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20.x
          cache: "pnpm"

      - run: pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run ci
        env:
          EXTERNAL_DRIVE_ROOT: "/example-root"

lockfileVersion: '6.0'

settings:
  autoInstallPeers: true
  excludeLinksFromLockfile: false

importers:

  .:
    dependencies:
      '@total-typescript/tsconfig':
        specifier: ^1.0.3
        version: 1.0.4
      '@types/node':
        specifier: ^20.12.10
        version: 20.14.11
      prettier:
        specifier: ^3.2.5
        version: 3.3.3
      turbo:
        specifier: ^2.0.1
        version: 2.0.7
      typescript:
        specifier: ^5.5.2
        version: 5.5.3
      vitest:
        specifier: ^2.0.0
        version: 2.0.3(@types/node@20.14.11)

  apps/_example-app:
    dependencies:
      example-package:
        specifier: workspace:*
        version: link:../../packages/_example-package

  packages/_example-package: {}

packages:

  /@ampproject/remapping@2.3.0:
    resolution: {integrity: sha512-30iZtAPgz+LTIYoeivqYo853f02jBYSd5uGnGpkFV0M3xOt9aN73erkgYAmZU43x4VfqcnLxW9Kpg3R5LC4YYw==}
